definitions.gloss: musical composition, piece of music, song, track
definitions.explanation: A completed piece of music, whether instrumental or vocal. A formal term that refers to any musical work as a finished composition.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{楽曲|がっきょく}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: They released a new piece of music.

examples.japanese: このアルバムには{全|ぜん}10{曲|きょく}の{楽曲|がっきょく}が{収録|しゅうろく}されている。
examples.english: This album contains a total of 10 tracks.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}のために{書|か}き{下|お}ろされた{楽曲|がっきょく}が、{後|のち}に{大|おお}ヒットした。
examples.english: A piece of music written specifically for the film later became a big hit.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{楽|がく} (music) + {曲|きょく} (tune, piece). Both elements relate to music.

USAGE:
{楽曲|がっきょく} is more formal than {曲|きょく} (song, tune) and is commonly used in the music industry, journalism, and formal descriptions of music. In casual conversation, {曲|きょく} alone is more natural. {楽曲|がっきょく} emphasizes the work as a composed piece of music.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽曲|がっきょく}を{制作|せいさく}する: to produce a piece of music
- {楽曲|がっきょく}を{提供|ていきょう}する: to provide a song (to an artist)
- {楽曲|がっきょく}{配信|はいしん}: music distribution/streaming
- オリジナル{楽曲|がっきょく}: original composition
- {人気|にんき}{楽曲|がっきょく}: popular song/track

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {曲|きょく}: song, tune (general, casual)
- {歌|うた}: song (specifically vocal music, everyday)

cross_references.label: song (typically a classical art song or formally composed song with lyrics)
